The '''Jedi strike team''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] led by [[Bastila Shan]] that participated in the [[Capture of Darth Revan|capture]] of [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] in the year [[3957 BBY]].

==History==
===The trap===
[[File:DarthRevanJediStrikeTeam-Timeline8.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Jedi strike team as depicted in Timeline 8: Jedi Civil War]]
In the year [[3957 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] set a [[Capture of Darth Revan|trap]] for [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. A contingent of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] commanded by [[Bastila Shan]] accompanied the fleet and led the mission. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council's]] gamble paid off when a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] fleet commanded by [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] himself engaged the small Republic force.<ref name="Kotor" />

Amidst the resulting fleet battle, Bastila Shan's strike team, made up of a mixed force of [[Republic Army|Republic military personnel]] and Jedi, managed to board [[Darth Revan's flagship]] and battle their way to the command deck. It is unknown how many Jedi were originally in the task force but at least four made it along with at least one [[Republic soldier]] to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] to engage Revan and his [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]]. Seemingly undaunted, Revan [[Death/Legends|struck down]] all who approached him. Standing on the command deck of his vessel, Revan [[Telekinesis/Legends|force choked]] the Republic soldier before readying himself to duel Bastila and her few remaining companions.<ref name="Kotor" />

===Darth Malak's betrayal===
In that moment of doubt, the ambitious [[Darth Malak]], Revan's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], decided that the time was right for his ascension to the rank of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. Seeing his chance to usurp his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master's]] title, Malak ordered his gunners to open fire upon the bridge of Revan's command ship, but all did not go as he had planned; the majority of the Jedi strike team was killed and Darth Revan's flagship was destroyed, but Revan himself survived. The remaining Jedi captured the critically injured Dark Lord and escaped the ship prior to its destruction.<ref name="Kotor" />

Bastila used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to save Revan's life, thus forming a powerful [[Force-bond/Legends|Force bond]] between them. The Jedi brought Revan before the Jedi Council who rebuilt his broken mind with a new personality loyal to the Republic in an effort to mask his true identity. In so doing, they hoped that Revan's subconscious memories would lead them to [[Star Forge|the source]] of the Sith's seemingly endless supply of military hardware. With his aid, they would attempt to locate it and destroy it at any cost.<ref name="Kotor" />

==Legacy==
{{Quote|Revan's mask! I thought it was lost when he was captured by the Jedi strike team.|Meetra Surik|<ref name="Tor: Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>}}
Unbeknownst to the Jedi Council, Bastila Shan, the leader of the strike team that captured Darth Revan, recovered [[Revan's mask|his mask]] and hid it for many years. She feared that the mask would not only cause Revan to regain all of his lost memories, but would also restore his original persona, as well as the dark side within him.<ref name="Tor: Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi strike team is created for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' where they are featured in a flashback cutscene. They are brought back in ''[[Timeline 8: The Jedi Civil War]]'' event for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
